source.selection: All 5 drug conditions × 3 author-supplied outcome categories × 3 biological replicates; no donor/Cas9 and NTC controls excluded explicitly. Outcome categories are retained verbatim and are not assumed to sum to 100%.

reading_question: Compare treatments within each of three author-supplied repair outcomes, using individual landscape subpanels. A global-scale grouped plot is an optional alternative when comparing absolute outcome magnitudes.
transfer: 4 treatments × 2 outcomes × 3 biological replicates, reversed CSV row order. The same geometry and neutral mark roles retain original source strings, means, sample SD and raw values.
candidate_decisions: Three independent 72 × 48 mm subpanels; 57.24 × 37.44 mm data regions, ratio 1.529; adopts a new case size after the user requested a major overhaul
Five-condition bars use .45 category pitch and graphite repeats, replacing the earlier .30 pitch and tall .897-ratio regions
Identical data-region margins, treatment order, font and stroke settings across outcomes
Explicit outcome-specific original-percent ranges, no hidden normalization and no comparison of absolute heights across differently scaled panels
Neutral open means distinguish summary role from graphite raw observations and SD; outcome identity is explicit in each y label
Unscaled side-by-side PDF/SVG overview preserves independent vector panels and Arial 8 pt text; representative HDR is used as the primary preview
Grouped alternative retains the global 0–55% scale, separate series colors and positive measured outline-stroke clearance
limits: Descriptive comparison only; no cross-condition pairing inferred, significance marks added, or new causal biological conclusion.
This has more measured outcomes than the single-HDR basic example. It is a different reading task, not a matched before/after aesthetic experiment.
Separate outcome ranges change the reading task from between-outcome absolute amounts to within-outcome treatment comparisons; both variants are labeled and retained.
design_revision: User-directed v0.4.4 overhaul, 2026-10-05; release held pending review
